messages:
mia: Quick sync  planning social push for the launch webinar. Need final 15s clip, stat card, and a pinned-reply test (clip vs stat) on X NA.

noah: Uploaded 15s + 9:16 to Drive: https://drive.redwood.ai/launch/15s. Also exported captioned version.

mia: great. can we burn captions for the 15s? many watch muted in stories.

noah: done. added burned captions in the folder.

eva: Copy variants in doc: metric-led, product-led, and dev-friendly. I recommend metric-led for X and dev-friendly for LinkedIn.

mia: agree. we'll A/B pinned reply on X NA for 24h: group A pinned demo clip, group B pinned stat card. Track demo bookings and CTR.

joel: Routing: /launch?utm_source=social&utm_campaign=microlaunch&utm_region=NA&utm_variant={A|B}. Demo booking adds &intent=demo. Webhook posts leads to HubSpot with tag social:microlaunch.

mia: SDR SOP: respond to comments/DMs within 2 hours weekdays with canned replies (demo clip link vs webinar signup). Put canned replies in shared doc.

eva: added canned replies and a short LinkedIn thread outline (tease -> benchmark excerpt -> CTA).

publish-bot: Reminder set: post drafts due Fri 17:00 PT in #marketing-assets. A/B window Tue 10:00 PT -> Wed 10:00 PT.

mia: paid boost plan: APAC boosted stories with gated PDF behind email capture. Make sure PDF headline matches social stat.

noah: stat overlay PNG done (brand navy / white bold). Exported 1200x675 + 1080x1080.

mia: analytics: measure CTR, demo bookings, webinar signups, and gated downloads per variant. Joel create dashboard widget.

joel: on it. will populate after 24h.

mia: blockers?

eva: translations for EU need quick QA (1hr).

noah: assets ready.

mia: thanks all  final tone pass Mon AM and then approve drafts. :rocket:
